preview.overview: Notre Dame brings an undefeated season and the College Football Belt to South Bend as they host a Michigan State team searching for consistency. The Spartans have split their last two games against ranked competition, while Notre Dame has been dominant, outscoring opponents by an average of over 40 points per game. Whoever emerges victorious will claim the belt that has been passed down since 1869.
key_matchups: Notre Dame's elite offensive line vs. Michigan State's pass rush defense
Michigan State's struggling secondary against Notre Dame's passing attack
The battle for field position and turnover margin in a rivalry game where special teams often decide close contests
preview.betting_angles: Notre Dame's recent form is historically dominant, with five consecutive blowout wins and an average margin of 33 points. Michigan State's defense has shown vulnerability against ranked opponents, particularly in coverage, while their offense has been inconsistent—the Spartans average just 23 points per game over their last five. The historical series heavily favors Notre Dame, who has won 44 of 73 meetings and covers the spread in their last three matchups against Michigan State dating back to 2016.
